title: Auth Semantics
description: Use for auth, session, permission, or access-control changes. Covers distinguishing unauthenticated, unauthorized, unavailable, and invalid-session states without broadening privileges.

requirements.statement: Fixes involving access/auth must distinguish unauthenticated, unauthorized, unavailable, and invalid-session states correctly; do not broaden privileges or force logout on mere permission denial unless that is the intended contract.
